amendments.decision: Execute the complete current-workflow compatibility, Phase 0 promotion, generation S1-S9, and evaluation S10-S13 implementation sequence through audits, required checks, outcomes, and commits without routine approval pauses. Live provider calls, independent hidden-gold authoring, push, and production promotion remain separate gates.

Before implementation, audit and commit the complete compatibility plus redesign S1-S14 planning package, then audit and commit all cold-turkey canonical design/configuration documents. Use one AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT for all chat roles and explicit AZURE_OPENAI_EVALUATION_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT. Add Slice 14 as a full backend audit/remediation gate and finish with a weekend summary. Frontend is concurrently owned by another agent, so avoid overlapping changes and never stage its work.

After verified replacements/parity, remove the 12 old runtime training directories, generate.md, repair.md, evidence-manifest.json, diagram-request.json, Grandalf/subprocess layout code and dependency, and old MCP registrations/contract IDs. Never remove user diagrams, .env, or local Graphviz files.
